title: Gruha : Bare-Metal Private Cloud & AI Automations
description: •Provisioned a 2-node bare-metal Kubernetes cluster using k3s, migrating self-hosted MinIO object storage and PostgreSQL workloads to StatefulSets with PersistentVolumeClaims for resilient, orchestrated private cloud infrastructure.\n•Architected a Zero Trust private network enforcing least-privilege service access with zero open firewall ports, exposing all internal Kubernetes services exclusively via Tailscale mesh VPN and Cloudflare Tunnels, achieving sub-50ms internal latency with full security compliance.\n•Built a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline deploying containerized workloads to the k3s cluster via kubectl, reducing push-to-production cycles to under 2 minutes across microservice repositories.

title: Intelligent Email to Tasks Manager
description: •Deployed and operated an email automation agent for ~1 year using Gemini API and Gmail OAuth, automating 80% of actionable email-to-task conversion and reducing triage time by 90% at scale.\n•Built a fault-tolerant distributed pipeline with Celery, Redis, and dead letter queues. Triaged and resolved production failures including malformed inputs and invalid payloads, achieving zero message loss across 15-minute polling cycles

title: SurajClaw: Personal AI Agent
description: •Built a personal AI agent on Django integrating 8+ MCP servers — Google Workspace, remote filesystem, PostgreSQL, bash execution, browser automation, and GitHub — enabling an autonomous development loop that writes, tests, and deploys code to production with minimal manual intervention.\n•Deployed all agent workloads on a private 2-node bare-metal Kubernetes cluster, routing execution across services over a Tailscale mesh network — achieving zero local compute dependency with full private-cloud isolation.\n•Implemented a persistent memory system using a curated Markdown knowledge base, enabling the agent to record learnings, errors, and documentation across sessions and reuse high-signal context in future runs.

title: Suraj Drive: Self-Hosted Google Drive
description: •Deployed Suraj Drive as a Kubernetes Deployment behind a ClusterIP Service, backed by MinIO S3-compatible storage and PostgreSQL on the private bare-metal cluster.\n•Implemented production-style storage service patterns including containerized Go APIs, persistent object storage, user-scoped access control, and private-network-only service exposure.\n•Configured Kubernetes resource limits and restart policies for Suraj Drive services, improving workload isolation and automatic recovery from container-level failures.
